'''Listehol''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Listehol system/Legends|Listehol system]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space. Later on it fell under control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
